text:
evelyn: heads-up: encountered a nasty JSON-mode interaction in the TS helper while migrating sample apps. Toolcall payloads with optional union types are being mutated during retry/auth-refresh.

jorge: can you show a tiny repro and which SDK/version?

evelyn: using @redwood/sdk-js v1.6.2. minimal repro using helper: 
```js
// initial call
client.callTool('create_job', { priority: undefined, retries: 3 })
// network/auth refresh triggers retry
// server receives: { priority: null, retries: "3" }
```
priority is optional enum | undefined; retries is number. On retry the undefined becomes null and number becomes string.

mike: thanks. sounds like two separate issues: missing-key -> null (py-ish behavior) and numeric -> string due to early stringify in retry queue. which transport? node-fetch server-side.

evelyn: yes node-fetch. i traced the code: auth-wrapper enqueues a shallow-cloned payload but then we run a normalize step that calls `Object.assign(defaults, payload)` before queueing. also retry wrapper stores `JSON.stringify(payload)` for backoff timers and reuses the string blob later.

jorge: ouch. that would explain both. defaults injecting nullish values and reuse of pre-serialized blob. both mutate shape/types.

qa-bot: sample test failing: samples/job-runner e2e  toolcall-retry-type.test.ts

mike: propose fix: 1) stop merging defaults on enqueue—keep original shape. 2) for queued retries store the raw args and a lightweight sentinel for absent keys (Symbol or unique string) so we can know what was originally omitted. 3) only stringify at send-time and run serializer that preserves number types.

evelyn: i hacked a sentinel locally (const UNSET = Symbol('UNSET')) and replace absent keys with UNSET in internal queue; serializer ignores UNSET. That preserves omission. Also changed retry to keep raw object rather than pre-serialized string - fixed numeric quoting.

evelyn: quick patch: in retry-wrapper replace `const body = JSON.stringify(args)` with `const bodyFactory = () => JSON.stringify(args)` and store bodyFactory for backoff timers, or better: store args reference safely (clone shallow) and call serializer on each attempt.

evelyn: one more nuance: streaming-mode uses chunk buffers; our streaming helper flattened chunks into a string when queueing which caused the numeric->string issue for streamed fields. need to keep chunk objects.

jorge: add tests: (1) optional enum absent vs null vs value, (2) number vs string union, (3) streaming chunked payload retry. include node-fetch + http2 matrix.

mike: also add cross-sdk parity tests comparing node vs python outputs for the same sample. we've had customers bitten by differences.

qa-bot: CI failures listed in samples/job-runner and samples/streaming-ingest.

evelyn: PR incoming with small changes: preserve raw args in queue, UNSET sentinel handling in serializer, streaming chunk object preservation. ran local e2e with netem token flip and tests pass.

mike: please include changelog: "fix(sdk): preserve absent optional fields and numeric types on retry in JSON mode for toolcall/function helpers" and note backports to 1.6.x and 1.5.x.

jorge: also add a small migration note for sample authors: if your sample asserted `field === null` you may need to change to explicit null handling. recommend a short blurb in upgrade guide.

evelyn: PR #4999 draft attached. i added repro scripts (netem token flip) and updated the sample tests.

qa-bot: created issue #6836: "sdk-js: retry queue mutates optional/union types in json-mode toolcalls"

sdk-team: ack; reviewing PR. include canary run on dedicated infra after merge.

evelyn: thanks all. ping me if you want the netem script or to run against a customer's dedicated cluster. will follow up once backports land. :thumbsup:
